brief.name: Antique serial message strip
brief.purpose: Tortoise telegraph and sequential message marks on a continuous strip
brief.learningIntent: SQ01; serial context, no universal electrical profile
brief.plannedMethod: Actual OpenAI base imagery with preserved original output; all exact labels/values in semantic UI, with manual diagrams/edits truthfully recorded

binding.alt: The Ancient Tortoise smiles beside its twin-coil telegraph; four marks run along one continuous paper strip.
binding.caption: Read the delivered strip left to right. The toy samples −3, +1, +3, −1 give the pairs 00, 10, 11, 01 and the message 00101101. The pictorial marks commemorate the order; they do not define a universal serial electrical profile.

conversion: Scale the full uncropped frame with Lanczos and encode RGB WebP at quality 88, method 6. No retouching or labels in the derivative.
